title: FBI Photo B14
what_is_it: A monochrome still image (photo) captured by a U.S. military system and submitted by the FBI to AARO as a UAP report.
interpretation_warnings: The extracted PDF text is garbled OCR noise from a photographic image — no readable text was recovered from the document body itself.
All factual content derives from the CSV metadata description and narrative description, not from text within the image.
Heavy redaction: the original imagery was altered before submission, and a redaction box with digital artifacts is present.
Single-source observation with no corroborating mission report provided.
The date/time stamp on the image is explicitly noted as incorrect, so no reliable timestamp exists.
The narrative description explicitly states it should not be interpreted as an analytical judgment or investigative conclusion.
